# Zoho Contracts to Zoho Sign Text Tag Registry

This registry is fail-closed: a field visible in the Zoho Sign editor is not assumed to have text-tag syntax. Only the simple tags below are approved for production Contracts content.

**Effective date:** 2026-07-15

## Evidence levels

- **Official grammar:** Recorded from Zoho's current automatic-field-addition documentation.
- **User-confirmed Contracts handoff:** `{{I:R1*}}` has been observed converting successfully.
- **Tenant smoke-test evidence:** None is recorded yet. Official grammar and tenant handoff proof are not treated as the same fact.

## Production-safe simple tags

| Field | Code | Exact example | Operational behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| Signature | `S` | `{{S:R1}}` | Captures the recipient's signature. |
| Initial | `I` | `{{I:R1}}` | Captures the recipient's initials. The user-confirmed {{I:R1*}} form is recorded separately as a compatibility alias. |
| Sign Date | `SD` | `{{SD:R1}}` | Zoho Sign fills this field only after the recipient signs; it is not a Contracts merge value or a pre-send date. |
| Date | `D` | `{{D:R1}}` | Collects a date entered by the recipient. |
| Full Name | `N` | `{{N:R1}}` | Adds the recipient full-name field. |
| First Name | `FN` | `{{FN:R1}}` | Adds the recipient first-name field. |
| Last Name | `LN` | `{{LN:R1}}` | Adds the recipient last-name field. |
| Email | `E` | `{{E:R1}}` | Adds the recipient email field. |
| Company | `CO` | `{{CO:R1}}` | Adds the recipient company field. |
| Job Title | `JT` | `{{JT:R1}}` | Adds the recipient job-title field. |
| Text | `TF` | `{{TF:R1*}}` | Collects recipient-entered text; append * when the text field must be mandatory. |
| Checkbox | `[]` | `{{[]}}` | Exact published shorthand for one checkbox. Approved only when an explicit recipient manifest contains R1 as the sole signer; configure mandatory behavior in the Sign editor unless a separate tenant smoke test proves tagged mandatory syntax. |
| Attachment | `A` | `{{A:R1}}` | Allows the recipient to attach a supporting document. |
| Stamp | `ST` | `{{ST:R1}}` | Adds a stamp field for the recipient. |

Zoho documents `*` as meaningful only for Text and Checkbox fields. The exact published checkbox shorthand `{{[]}}` is approved here only for an explicitly manifested single R1 signer and does not encode mandatory behavior; configure a required checkbox in the Sign editor unless a separate smoke test proves a role-specific tagged form. A redundant `*` on Signature (`S`) or Initial (`I`) is accepted for compatibility, including the user-confirmed `{{I:R1*}}`; do not infer additional semantics from it. Sign Date (`SD`) is populated by Zoho Sign only after the recipient signs.

## Official syntax blocked pending Contracts-pipeline testing

| Field | Exact official syntax example | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Formatted Sign Date | `{{SD:R1:(dateformat="MMM dd yyyy")}}` | `blocked_until_smoke_tested` |
| Dropdown | `{{DD:R1:Text(options="option 1, option 2, option 3")}}` | `blocked_until_smoke_tested` |
| Radio | `{{(Radio1):Recipient1:RadioA}}` | `blocked_until_smoke_tested` |
| Checkbox Group | `{{CBG:Recipient1:checkboxgroup-1[checkbox1]}}` | `blocked_until_smoke_tested` |

The formatted Sign Date syntax is official, including `{{SD:R1:(dateformat="MMM dd yyyy")}}`. A user reported that it did not autopopulate, but that observation is ambiguous: preview conversion and post-signature value population are different checks because Sign Date is blank until signing. Keep it blocked until both stages pass separately; use `{{SD:R1}}` meanwhile.

## Other published features blocked by GHRE

Zoho also publishes longhand and recipient-omitting examples, broad named-field grammar, font parameters, and trailing-space width padding. They are reference material, not production allowlist entries:

- **published_longhand_and_shorthand_examples** — `{{Signature}}`, `{{S}}`, `{{Company:Recipient2}}`, `{{CO:R2}}`, `{{Textfield:Recipient1*}}`, `{{TF:R1*}}`, `{{Jobtitle}}`, `{{JT}}`, `{{Initial}}`, `{{I}}`, `{{Signdate}}`, `{{SD}}`, `{{Checkbox}}`, `{{[]}}`, `{{Fullname}}`, `{{N}}`, `{{Customdate:Recipient1}}`, `{{D:R1}}`, `{{Firstname}}`, `{{FN}}`, `{{Lastname}}`, `{{LN}}`, `{{Attachment}}`, `{{A}}`, `{{Stamp}}`, `{{ST}}`, `{{Email}}`, `{{E}}`. Policy: `blocked_without_explicit_R_role`. GHRE uses explicit shorthand recipient roles for deterministic multi-recipient templates.
- **omitted_recipient_defaults_to_first** — `{{S}}`, `{{I}}`, `{{SD}}`. Policy: `forbidden`. Zoho defaults an omitted recipient to the first recipient; GHRE requires an explicit recipient-role manifest and role-bearing tags except the exact single-recipient checkbox shorthand.
- **general_field_name_grammar** — `{{<field type>:Recipient<n>:<field name in case of text field>*}}`. Policy: `blocked_until_smoke_tested`. Named-field grammar is broader than the production allowlist and is not accepted by the scanner.
- **font_parameters** — `{{<field type>:recipient<n>:<field name in case of text field>*(font="<Font Name>":fontsize="<font_size>":fontcolor="<color_code>")}}`, `{{Textfield:Recipient1:Address*(font="Roboto";fontsize="24";fontcolor="ff0077")}}`. Policy: `contracts_pipeline_unverified_and_blocked`. The official generic form uses colon separators while its example uses semicolons. Because the published separators are internally inconsistent, GHRE does not guess and requires an isolated tenant smoke test.
- **trailing_width_padding** — `{{S:R1          }}`. Policy: `forbidden`. Zoho documents trailing spaces to increase field width. GHRE forbids them so source scans and diffs remain deterministic; adjust placement in a governed Sign template instead.

No dedicated official text tag is published for Image, Payment, Formula, or Split Text. Zoho's current text-tag table also does not publish a dedicated Phone tag. Place those fields through the Sign editor, a governed Sign template, or the API as described above; tags such as `{{Phone:R1}}`, `{{Image:R1}}`, `{{Payment:R1}}`, `{{Formula:R1}}`, and `{{SplitText:R1}}` are rejected.

## Safety rules

- Maximum document length: **74 pages** (Zoho documents the feature for documents less than 75 pages).
- Maximum recipient manifest: **25 recipients**, matching Zoho Sign's sending limit.
- Keep every tag on one physical line and use ASCII braces and straight double quotes.
- Declare recipients explicitly as R1-R25; implicit first-recipient assignment is not allowed in governed content.
- Every signer in the recipient-role manifest must have at least one assigned field, and every tag recipient must appear in the manifest.
- Complex, formatted, unknown, or invented tags fail the production scanner.
